questions.why: with him의 him을 whom으로 바꾸어 전치사 with와 함께 절 앞으로 보낸다.

questions.stem: The scientist ____ research changed the world received a big prize.
questions.why: research가 그 과학자의 연구이므로 소유격 whose를 쓴다. whose research가 절의 주어가 된다.

questions.stem: We stayed at a hotel ____ windows looked out over the ocean.
questions.why: windows가 그 호텔의 창문이므로 소유격 whose가 알맞다. which·that 뒤에는 명사가 바로 올 수 없다.

questions.stem: The classmate with ____ I share a desk moved to Busan last week.
questions.why: 전치사 with의 목적어이고 선행사가 사람이므로 whom을 쓴다. 전치사 뒤에는 who·that을 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: This is the app ____ I found the recipe for the soup.
questions.why: '그 앱에서 요리법을 찾았다'는 find ~ in the app이므로 전치사 in이 필요하다. 전치사와 함께 쓰려면 in which로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: The village ____ people welcomed us is near the border.
questions.why: people이 그 마을의 사람들이므로 소유격 whose를 쓴다.

questions.stem: Mr. Han is the coach to ____ our team owes its victory.
questions.why: owe A to B의 to 뒤 목적어 자리이고 선행사가 사람이므로 whom을 쓴다.

questions.stem: She showed me an old photo in ____ her father was smiling.
questions.why: 전치사 in의 목적어이고 선행사가 사물 an old photo이므로 which를 쓴다.

questions.stem: I don't like stories ____ endings are too sad.
questions.why: endings가 그 이야기들의 결말이므로 소유격 whose를 쓴다. 선행사가 사물이어도 소유격은 whose이다.

questions.stem: The company for ____ my mother works makes electric buses.
questions.why: 전치사 for의 목적어이고 선행사 the company는 사물(회사)이므로 which를 쓴다.

questions.stem: Jiho is the only student ____ project was chosen for the fair.

questions.stem: That is the tall building on ____ we saw the sunset last summer.

questions.stem: I still remember the summer night ____ we talked until dawn.

questions.answer: She is the doctor to whom I sent a thank-you card.
questions.why: to her의 her를 whom으로 바꾸어 전치사 to와 함께 앞으로 보낸다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 whose를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — We visited a castle. Its walls were built 500 years ago.
questions.answer: We visited a castle whose walls were built 500 years ago.
questions.why: Its walls를 whose walls로 바꾼다. 사물의 소유격도 whose로 쓴다.

questions.stem: 전치사를 관계대명사 앞으로 보내어 다시 쓰시오. — That is the hospital which my sister was born in.
questions.answer: That is the hospital in which my sister was born.
questions.why: 문장 끝의 전치사 in을 관계대명사 앞으로 보내면 in which가 된다.

questions.stem: 전치사를 관계대명사 앞으로 보내어 다시 쓰시오. — He is the man who I was waiting for.
questions.answer: He is the man for whom I was waiting.
questions.why: 전치사를 앞으로 보내면 who는 쓸 수 없고 목적격 whom을 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「전치사＋which」를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — I lost the key. I open the back door with it.
questions.answer: I lost the key with which I open the back door.
questions.why: with it의 it을 which로 바꾸어 with와 함께 관계대명사절 앞으로 보낸다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 whose를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — The boy is my cousin. His drawing was on the wall.
questions.answer: The boy whose drawing was on the wall is my cousin.
questions.why: His drawing을 whose drawing으로 바꾸어 선행사 The boy 뒤에 붙인다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The man whose car was towed away complained to the police. ㄴ. This is the tool with that we opened the wooden box. ㄷ. The child to whom she read a story fell asleep at once. ㄹ. I know a house which windows face the south.
questions.why: ㄴ은 전치사 뒤에 that을 쓸 수 없어 with which로, ㄹ은 소유 관계이므로 which를 whose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The building whose roof is made of glass opened last month. ㄴ. She is the only friend on who I can depend. ㄷ. The bench on which we carved our names is still there. ㄹ. The dog whom owner is a vet never barks.
questions.why: ㄴ은 전치사 뒤에 who를 쓸 수 없어 on whom, ㄹ은 소유 관계이므로 whom을 whose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The novel which title I forgot won a prize. ㄴ. The novel whose title I forgot won a prize. ㄷ. The novel the title of which I forgot won a prize. ㄹ. The novel about which we argued won a prize.
questions.why: 사물의 소유격은 whose 또는 「the＋명사＋of which」로 쓴다. ㄱ은 which를 whose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. He has three cousins, all of who live abroad. ㄴ. She showed me a ring whose stone was missing. ㄷ. The room in which the meeting was held had no windows. ㄹ. That is the shelf on that I keep my dictionaries.
questions.why: ㄱ은 of 뒤에 목적격이 와야 하므로 all of whom, ㄹ은 전치사 뒤에 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 on which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 whose가 들어갈 문장끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. I met a violinist ____ bow was broken. ㄴ. This is the café in ____ they first met. ㄷ. We stayed in a cabin ____ walls smelled of pine. ㄹ. He is the coach to ____ the players listen.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ은 빈칸 뒤에 명사가 바로 오는 소유 관계이므로 whose, ㄴ은 which, ㄹ은 whom이 들어간다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 which가 들어갈 문장끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The ship on ____ they sailed was very old. ㄴ. The captain with ____ they sailed was very brave. ㄷ. The town ____ harbor we visited is small. ㄹ. The map on ____ the island is marked is mine.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄹ은 전치사 뒤 사물 선행사이므로 which, ㄴ은 사람이므로 whom, ㄷ은 소유 관계이므로 whose가 들어간다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The artist whose the paintings we saw is from Spain. ㄴ. The desk under which the cat hid is heavy. ㄷ. The person from whom I heard the news is reliable. ㄹ. The library which books are old will close soon.
questions.why: ㄱ은 whose 뒤에 관사를 쓸 수 없고, ㄹ은 소유 관계이므로 which를 whose로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The company for which my aunt works exports coffee. ㄴ. I know a boy whose parents run a bakery. ㄷ. This is the pen with what he wrote the poem. ㄹ. The hotel at that we stayed was near the beach.
questions.why: ㄷ은 what을 which로, ㄹ은 that을 which로 고쳐야 한다. what과 that은 전치사 바로 뒤에 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. The teacher who advice I followed was Ms. Park. ㄴ. The mountain the top of which is always white is Baekdu. ㄷ. The friends with whom I traveled took these photos. ㄹ. The box in whom I found the letters was locked.
questions.why: ㄱ은 who를 whose로, ㄹ은 사물 선행사이므로 whom을 which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것끼리 짝지은 것은? ㄱ. This is the reason for that he refused our offer. ㄴ. He is a writer whose stories are read all over Asia. ㄷ. The stage on which the band played was very small. ㄹ. I have a bike of whose color is bright yellow.
questions.why: ㄱ은 전치사 뒤에 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 for which, ㄹ은 whose color로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The scientist whose lecture we attended is from Canada. ⓑ This is the tunnel through that the fast train passes. ⓒ The woman to whom I gave my seat thanked me twice. ⓓ I read a poem whose meaning was hard to catch. ⓔ The mountain whom top is white is Mt. Halla.
questions.why: ⓐ·ⓒ·ⓓ가 옳다. ⓑ는 through which, ⓔ는 whose top으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The girl whose story moved us won the contest. ⓑ The chair on which he stood was not strong. ⓒ The man to who I gave the ticket disappeared. ⓓ The house which door is painted red is ours. ⓔ The tool with which she fixed the bike was tiny.
questions.why: ⓐ·ⓑ·ⓔ가 옳다. ⓒ는 to whom, ⓓ는 whose door로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는? ⓐ I know a singer whose voice is deep and warm. ⓑ The pond in that the ducks swim froze last night. ⓒ The doctor from who she got the news called again. ⓓ The building whose windows are round is a museum. ⓔ The desk at which I study faces the window.
questions.why: ⓑ(in which)와 ⓒ(from whom) 두 문장이 틀렸다. 전치사 뒤에는 that과 who를 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The village whose name nobody remembers is on the map. ⓑ The bridge under which we walked was built in 1980. ⓒ The friend with whom I share a room is from Jeju. ⓓ The novel whose the ending shocked me is a classic. ⓔ The cup out of which he drank was made of clay.
questions.why: ⓓ만 틀렸다. whose 뒤에는 관사 없이 명사가 바로 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The actor which name I forgot appeared again. ⓑ The room in which the piano stands is warm. ⓒ The teacher to whom we sent flowers retired. ⓓ This is the reason for that she cried. ⓔ The dog whose leg was hurt is getting better.
questions.why: ⓐ(whose name)와 ⓓ(for which) 두 문장이 틀렸다. 나머지는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ He is the only student whose homework was perfect. ⓑ The shop from which I bought this coat closed down. ⓒ The team with whose we played was very fast. ⓓ The lake around which we ran is quite large. ⓔ The writer of whom books are famous lives here.
questions.why: ⓐ·ⓑ·ⓓ가 옳다. ⓒ는 with which, ⓔ는 whose books로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는? ⓐ I have a friend whose father repairs old clocks. ⓑ The train on which we traveled had no lights. ⓒ The girl about who they talked left early. ⓓ The tree whose branches broke fell on the road. ⓔ The knife with that he cut the rope was rusty.
questions.why: ⓒ(about whom)와 ⓔ(with which) 두 문장이 틀렸다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는? ⓐ The country the flag of which is red and white is Poland. ⓑ The country whose flag is red and white is Poland. ⓒ The country of which flag is red and white is Poland. ⓓ The country of which the flag is red and white is Poland. ⓔ The country which flag is red and white is Poland.
questions.why: 사물의 소유격은 whose, the＋명사＋of which, of which the＋명사의 세 가지로 쓴다. ⓒ와 ⓔ는 어순·형태가 잘못되었다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The reporter <u>whose</u> question <u>surprised</u> the mayor works for a paper <u>in</u> <u>that</u> many people <u>trust</u>.
questions.why: 전치사 in 바로 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 in which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The chef <u>with</u> <u>whom</u> we cooked <u>runs</u> a restaurant <u>which</u> <u>walls</u> are covered with photos.
questions.why: walls가 그 식당의 벽이므로 which가 아니라 소유격 whose를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The island <u>to</u> <u>which</u> we sailed <u>has</u> a lighthouse <u>whose</u> <u>the</u> light can be seen for miles.
questions.why: whose 뒤에는 관사를 쓰지 않으므로 the를 빼고 whose light로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The professor <u>from</u> <u>who</u> I learned statistics <u>wrote</u> a book <u>on</u> <u>which</u> my report is based.
questions.why: 전치사 from 뒤에는 who를 쓸 수 없고 목적격 whom을 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — I visited a school <u>whose</u> students <u>grow</u> vegetables <u>in</u> a garden <u>about</u> <u>that</u> the town is proud.
questions.why: 전치사 about 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 about which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The old woman <u>whom</u> <u>garden</u> we admired <u>invited</u> us <u>for</u> tea <u>last</u> Sunday.
questions.why: garden이 그 할머니의 정원이므로 whom이 아니라 소유격 whose를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — The library <u>in</u> <u>which</u> I study every day <u>has</u> a reading room <u>with</u> <u>whom</u> I fell in love.
questions.why: 선행사 a reading room이 사물이므로 whom이 아니라 which를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은? — He described the accident <u>in</u> <u>which</u> his uncle <u>was</u> hurt and the hospital <u>to</u> <u>that</u> he was taken.
questions.why: 전치사 to 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 to which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 옮긴 것은? — I called the woman. Her wallet was found on the bus.
choices: I called the woman who wallet was found on the bus.
I called the woman whose wallet was found on the bus.
I called the woman whom wallet was found on the bus.
I called the woman of whom wallet was found on the bus.
I called the woman whose wallet it was found on the bus.
questions.why: Her wallet을 whose wallet으로 바꾸어 연결한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장을 전치사를 관계대명사 앞에 두어 바꿔 쓴 것으로 옳은 것은? — She is the friend that I depend on most.
choices: She is the friend on that I depend most.
She is the friend on who I depend most.
She is the friend on whom I depend most.
She is the friend whose I depend on most.
She is the friend on which I depend most.
questions.why: 전치사를 앞으로 보내면 that·who는 쓸 수 없고, 사람 선행사이므로 on whom이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 옮긴 것은? — He showed us a photo. In the photo his grandfather was in uniform.
choices: He showed us a photo in that his grandfather was in uniform.
He showed us a photo which his grandfather was in uniform.
He showed us a photo whose his grandfather was in uniform.
He showed us a photo in which his grandfather was in uniform.
He showed us a photo in whom his grandfather was in uniform.
questions.why: In the photo의 the photo를 which로 바꾸어 in which로 연결한다.

questions.stem: 다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 옮긴 것은? — I have five pens. Three of them are blue.
choices: I have five pens, three of them are blue.
I have five pens, three of whose are blue.
I have five pens, three of whom are blue.
I have five pens, three of that are blue.
I have five pens, three of which are blue.
questions.why: of 뒤에 목적격이 오고 선행사가 사물이므로 three of which로 이어야 한다. ①은 접속사가 없어 두 절을 이을 수 없다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오. — I have three close friends, all ____ ____ live in the same town. (of를 포함할 것)
questions.why: 계속적 용법에서 부분을 나타낼 때는 「부분사＋of＋목적격」을 쓰며, 선행사가 사람이므로 of whom이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오. — She wrote ten poems, three ____ ____ were about the sea. (of를 포함할 것)
questions.why: 선행사 ten poems가 사물이므로 three of which로 이어야 한다. of 뒤에는 목적격 which를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오. — The old temple, the roof ____ ____ was rebuilt last year, is worth visiting. (of를 포함할 것)
questions.why: 사물의 소유 관계는 「the＋명사＋of which」로 나타낼 수 있으며, whose roof was rebuilt와 같은 뜻이다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 관계대명사를 한 단어로 쓰시오. — The candidate for ____ most students voted gave a short speech.
questions.why: vote for의 for 뒤 목적어 자리이고 선행사가 사람이므로 whom을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 빈칸에 알맞은 관계대명사를 한 단어로 쓰시오. — The theory on ____ his whole study depends has not been proved.
questions.why: depend on의 on 뒤 목적어 자리이고 선행사 The theory가 사물이므로 which를 쓴다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. — The hospital <u>to that</u> the injured driver was taken is nearby.
questions.why: 전치사 바로 뒤에는 that을 쓸 수 없으므로 to which로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 두 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. — He has four brothers, two <u>of them</u> are twins.
questions.why: 접속사 없이 두 절을 이을 수 없으므로 them을 관계대명사 whom으로 바꾸어 two of whom으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. — I moved into a flat <u>whose the</u> windows face the river.
questions.why: whose 뒤에는 관사를 쓰지 않고 명사가 바로 와야 하므로 the를 빼야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. — The committee members, none of <u>which</u> agreed with the plan, left early.
questions.why: 선행사 The committee members가 사람이므로 none of whom으로 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 한 단어로 고쳐 쓰시오. — The desk under <u>whose</u> I found my ring belongs to my sister.
questions.why: whose 뒤에는 명사가 와야 하며, 여기서는 전치사 under 뒤 사물 선행사를 받는 which를 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 whose를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — The reporter asked a hard question. Her voice was shaking.
questions.answer: The reporter whose voice was shaking asked a hard question.
questions.why: Her voice를 whose voice로 바꾸어 선행사 The reporter 바로 뒤에 넣는다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「the＋명사＋of which」를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — I bought an old clock. Its hands were made of gold.
questions.answer: I bought an old clock the hands of which were made of gold.
questions.why: 사물의 소유격은 whose 대신 「the＋명사＋of which」로도 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「부분사＋of＋관계대명사」를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — I invited twenty guests. Most of them came on time.
questions.answer: I invited twenty guests, most of whom came on time.
questions.why: them을 목적격 관계대명사 whom으로 바꾸어 most of whom으로 잇는다. 선행사가 사람이므로 which는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「부분사＋of＋관계대명사」를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — He gave me six roses. Two of them were already dead.
questions.answer: He gave me six roses, two of which were already dead.
questions.why: 선행사 six roses가 사물이므로 two of which로 이어야 한다.

questions.stem: 전치사를 관계대명사 앞으로 보내어 문장을 다시 쓰시오. — That is the coach that our team relies on.
questions.answer: That is the coach on whom our team relies.
questions.why: 전치사를 앞으로 보내면 that은 쓸 수 없고, 사람 선행사이므로 on whom이 된다.

questions.stem: 전치사를 관계대명사 앞으로 보내어 문장을 다시 쓰시오. — This is the ladder which he climbed up.
questions.answer: This is the ladder up which he climbed.
questions.why: 문장 끝의 전치사 up을 관계대명사 앞으로 보내면 up which가 된다.

questions.stem: whose를 사용하여 같은 뜻의 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오. — I read a report the conclusion of which was quite surprising.
questions.answer: I read a report whose conclusion was quite surprising.
questions.why: 「the＋명사＋of which」는 사물의 소유격 whose＋명사로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「전치사＋whom」을 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — He is the neighbor. I often leave my keys with him.
questions.answer: He is the neighbor with whom I often leave my keys.
questions.why: with him의 him을 whom으로 바꾸어 전치사 with와 함께 절 앞으로 보낸다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 「전치사＋which」를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — I will never forget the day. We first met on that day.
questions.answer: I will never forget the day on which we first met.
questions.why: on that day의 that day를 which로 바꾸어 on which로 잇는다.

questions.stem: 두 문장을 whose를 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓰시오. — We passed a factory. Its chimneys were pouring out black smoke.
questions.answer: We passed a factory whose chimneys were pouring out black smoke.
questions.why: Its chimneys를 whose chimneys로 바꾸어 연결한다. 사물의 소유격도 whose이다.
